tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.special_circumstance: premature termination of term deposits due to death of the depositor (even if within the lock-in period)
tuples.quote: 226. A UCB shall incorporate a clause in the account opening form itself to the effect that in the event of death of the depositor, premature termination of term deposits would be allowed without any penal charge, even if the deposit is within the lock-in- period.
